title: Diagnostic Value of FAR, CAR, and PNI in Differentiating Benign From Malignant Endometrial Lesions and Assessing High-Risk Pathological Features.
snippet: Benign endometrial lesions and endometrial cancer often overlap in clinical and ultrasonographic features. This study evaluated the ability of the fibrinogen-to-albumin ratio (FAR), C-reactive protein-to-albumin ratio (CAR), and prognostic nutritional index (PNI) to differentiate benign endometrial lesions from endometrial cancer and examined their associat...
